en.title: Rhythm of Stressed Syllables
en.summary: Learn how stressed syllables create Romanian rhythm while unstressed syllables stay quick and light.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: Romanian rhythm relies on strong beats. Stressed syllables sound clear and loud. Unstressed syllables pass by quickly. Listen to (mulțumesc) /mul.t͡suˈmesk/ (mult) /mult/, which means thank you very much. The beat falls firmly on the loud parts. The weak parts move fast and light.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Push more air from your lungs on stressed beats. Open your mouth wider on those parts. Say the unstressed parts with less breath. Do not stop between beats. Let your voice bounce smoothly from beat to beat. Keep your pitch natural and lively.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Every word has one main beat. Find the stressed vowel first. Give that vowel extra time and strength. Read the word (bine) /ˈbi.ne/, which means well. The first part is long and strong. The second part is short and quiet. Move through the quiet vowels quickly.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not give every part equal weight. Speech is not flat like a ticking clock. If you make every vowel loud, you sound stiff. Do not drop unstressed vowels completely either. Keep them short, but do not swallow them. Balance strong beats with light, quick sounds.
